description: Passing a prop through components that only forward it to reach a deep descendant.
`createContext(defaultValue)` creates a context object. Call it at module level.
React 19: `<MyContext value={...}>`. Older: `<MyContext.Provider value={...}>`. The nearest one above a consumer wins.
Read the nearest provided value. `use(Context)` may be called conditionally.
Used only when no provider exists above the consumer.
